requirements.detail: Keep Orchestrator as projection-and-control over canonical runtime contracts; do not let page-layer redefine scheduler/event semantics.
Expose requested versus effective provider/model/persona and support independent config surfaces at seam/package/node scopes.
Formalize seam-level acceptance dimensions: operability, state coherence, workflow completeness, UX coherence, and architectural coherence.
Graph view must preserve full lineage at large scale with zoom-dependent labels, minimap/pan/zoom, and search focus across seam/package/node/lane/generation.

decisions.detail: Work remains in research mode, status should stay active, and continuity remains in this work item/thread.
Governance direction favors deterministic runtime scheduler with bounded worker/remediation agents and optional corroboration.
Preferred default for dependent nodes in one package is same-lane continuation; promote-then-fork is exceptional.

data_shapes.detail: Promotion model requires explicit classes and gateable state transitions: lane_to_package, package_to_seam_available, seam_complete.
Seam review output artifact shape: verdict, severity-tagged failure classes, evidence bundle, remediation or graph-patch recommendation, corroboration outcome.
Canonical contracts need identity fields spanning package_id, seam_id, lane_id, attempt_id, and effective identity attributes.

routing_rules.detail: Run seam review at package completion, integration-edge crossings, pre-seam completion, and when package overseer raises high-impact challenge.
Treat source-control/worktree handshake and cross-surface lineage navigation as first-class routing seams in Orchestrator design.
Recovery sequencing routes through owner-doc fixes first, then consumer/mirror cleanup, then fidelity audit rerun.

verification_rules.detail: Corroboration quorum: 2-of-3 accepts high-impact claim; otherwise downgrade to non-blocking advisory/minor finding if concern remains credible.
lane_to_package promotion gate validates local correctness, uncontaminated lane state, required automated checks, and promotable outputs.
package_to_seam_available gate validates trusted package baseline, evidence, acceptable package-overseer verdict, and seam-consumable outputs.
seam_complete gate validates integration quality, no major/critical unresolved issues, workflow completeness, GUI/runtime alignment, and no pending corroboration/remediation.

owner_consumer_obligations.detail: Package overseer remains bounded to local supervision, worker dispatch/review cadence, and package-local remediation recommendation.
Feature-seam overseer obligation is seam-level integration judgment and ability to withhold seam completion on weak integration.
Settings/runtime owners must support provider/account/role-level auto-switch policies, with default auto-switch on for provider-using execution actors.

stale_retirement_items.detail: Retire tier-first constructs in core docs and widgets (tiers tab, tier tree, phase/task/subtask authority) under package/seam/lane governance.
Retire split-brain execution truth between active-agents.json local state and event-sourced storage authorities.
Retire blocked payload naming drift and unify around normalized blocked reason/action contract family.

open_questions.detail: What is the final Orchestrator model: direct graph execution, projection layer, or tier-like meta model; and who owns top-level governance authority?
What is precedence and constraint behavior for provider/model/persona across run/seam/package/node/overseer/delegated-worker contexts?
How should snapshot/safe-point/restore policy map to lane/package/seam/remediation scopes and failure classes?

process_defects.detail: High addenda density and body-vs-addenda divergence create recurring local-authority conflicts and supersession ambiguity.
Scheduler contract split between lexicographic schema constants and scored runtime scheduler is an active process/contract defect.
Storage/contract normalization defects persist around contamination, safe-point linkage, package/seam/lane state, and blocked payload shape.

doc_hints.detail: Highest-risk canon-collapse hotspots include orchestrator integration, HITL, usage, GUI spec, contracts, and storage plan docs.
Research follow-up should include dual-overseer spec, lane-to-worktree mapping, effective identity contract, and pathing migration.
Stewardship refreshes must preserve packet metadata continuity and avoid resetting packetized state.
